title: MedFlow AI
shortDesc: Hospital workflow triage and role-based operational coordination system.
problem: Hospitals waste over 40% of nursing and admin hours manually routing patient intake, staff allocation, and shift handover requests across fragmented channels.
whatWeBuilt: Built a role-aware operational triage hub integrating clinical intake forms, automated patient queue routing, and real-time operational notifications.
honestScopeNote: Initial architecture deployed a rules-based triage chatbot with human-in-the-loop escalation rather than a fully autonomous agentic loop to guarantee zero medical hallucination risk.
